title: Rootly Agent: actions users asked for that the agent did not allow (homepage redesign input)
symptom: Users ask Rootly Agent to take actions (update/resolve incidents, page people, declare incidents, write retros, Slack channel actions) and the agent replies that it can't. No outage; this is a capability gap measured for the homepage redesign.
affected_surface: Rootly Agent chat: Slack, web incident chat (mostly read-only), web home chat, mobile, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, API

timeline.event: Earliest ai_sessions / ai_session_messages data on chat surfaces in the 90-day window
ai_tool_call_events starts recording tool-level outcomes (denied, permission_denied, held)
Homepage redesign kickoff follow-up in #proj-homepage-redesign asks for numbers on actions users asked for that the agent did not allow
Lane pulled the numbers from Metabase (Main DB); Braintrust queries were blocked by the read-only hook; ranked report published at tmp/soil/report.html

summary: Not a production incident. Kickoff follow-up for the homepage redesign: pull numbers on actions users asked Rootly Agent to do that it would not or could not do. Paying non-sandbox teams, chat surfaces, last 90 days: at least 268 action requests were refused. The flag's precision is about 80% (41 of 50 sampled); recall was not measured. Ranked by teams refused: update incident (34), Slack channel/bridge actions (30), send/post message (27), page/escalate (25), retrospective create/fill/publish (25), declare incident (21), external tickets (14). Web chat refuses incident updates, paging and retros at 33%, 40% and 60%; the reason given is that web is read-only. Home chat has no tools for declare incident, paging, status page, retros, Slack channel actions or Jira.

findings: No structured refusal tag exists: guardrail and 'no tool for that' replies are plain assistant text (config/ai/guardrails.yml).
Tool-level denials are recorded in ai_tool_call_events.outcome (denied, permission_denied, held) via app/services/ai/tool_calls/recorder.rb.

Home chat write tools: app/services/ai/tools/home_write_allowlist.rb. It excludes create incident, paging, status page, retros, Slack channel actions and Jira; incident updates only behind the enable_ai_assistant_required_fields_v2 flag.

triage.deploys: not_applicable: no regression or outage is being investigated
triage.ci: not_applicable: no code change in this lane

observability.metabase: available; all numbers come from Main DB (id 2): ai_session_messages, ai_sessions, ai_tool_call_events, ai_pending_checkpoints, ai_allowed_tools
observability.braintrust: blocked: sql_query and infer_schema refused by the lane's read-only hook; no Braintrust numbers used or estimated
observability.datadog: not queried: [Ai::CapabilityMissing] logs cover agent-disabled and failed turns, not action refusals

data_gaps: Braintrust queries blocked by read-only hook (same as operator session).
No structured refusal tag; counts come from text classification and are lower bounds.
ai_pending_checkpoints has no tool column, so the 1,119 expired confirmations (all teams, 90d) cannot be ranked by action.
Some totals (23.7k sessions, checkpoints) include internal and QA teams; the ranked table is limited to paying teams.
